The project

A modern coastal landmark

Pacific Sunset Hotel & Resort is planned as a ten-storey tower near Dolphin Moar in Kolatoli, designed around views of the sea, the city and the hills, with guest-focused spaces and natural light and ventilation.

A concern of Rimmy Estate Limited.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Where is the project?

Bypass Road, Kolatoli, Cox’s Bazar.

When will it open?

The planned handover is 2029, subject to management confirmation.

How do I ask about ownership or investment?

Submit the enquiry form. A representative will explain the approved process.

Are returns guaranteed?

No. This website makes no promise of profit or fixed return. Risks and disclosures will be provided in approved documents.

Does ownership mean guaranteed income?

No. Distributions, if any, depend on actual performance and the approved agreement.

Can I visit the site?

Yes – book a site visit through the enquiry form or the hotline.
